import os, django
os.environ.setdefault('DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE', 'settings')
django.setup()
from django.core.management import call_command
call_command('migrate', run_syncdb=True, verbosity=0)
from shop.models import Book
Book.objects.create(title='Old', author='A', published_year=1999)
Book.objects.create(title='Mid', author='B', published_year=2001)
Book.objects.create(title='New', author='C', published_year=2010)
titles = [b.title for b in Book.recent(2000)]
assert titles == ['New', 'Mid'], f'recent(2000) wrong (want newest first, >= year): {titles}'
assert Book.recent(2011).count() == 0, 'recent past the newest year should be empty'
b = Book.objects.get(title='New')
assert b.created_at is not None, 'created_at must be auto-populated'
